name: Law Enforcement
overview: Scripture reveals that God is our ultimate protector and strength in times of trouble, guiding and empowering those who uphold justice. Believers are called to defend the vulnerable, such as the poor and fatherless, and to act boldly and righteously, reflecting the courage of a lion. The Lord equips His people to stand firm against enemies and to carry out the work of justice with strength and resolve, trusting in His sustaining hand.
